articles.title: 890 millions d'euros ! Google se voit à tour imposé une amende record de la part de Bruxelles
articles.text:
L'Union européenne annonce une nouvelle amende. Cette fois, elle touche Google, et frise le milliard d'euros !
En début de semaine, Bruxelles annonçait infliger une amende de 550 millions d'euros au géant chinois de l'e-commerce AliExpress. Une sanction en lien avec le Digital Services Act, un des deux règlements européens destinés à réguler l'activité sur internet. Aujourd'hui, c'est au nom du second de ces règlements, le Digital Markets Act (DMA), que la Commission européenne impose une amende exceptionnelle à Google.
Une amende de 890 millions d'euros tombe sur Google
Google était sous le coup d'une enquête de l'Union européenne depuis 2024, au titre du DMA. Une enquête qui s'achève aujourd'hui avec l'annonce d'une amende de 890 millions d'euros infligée au géant américain - un montant record pour ce qui est du DMA.
La première partie de cette amende, à savoir 460 millions d'euros, est justifiée par le fait que Google favorise ses propres services par rapport à la concurrence dans les résultats donnés par Google Search. Les 430 millions d'euros restants le sont à cause des efforts de Google pour empêcher les développeurs présents sur son Play Store d'orienter les clients vers les magasins alternatives.
Vers une nouvelle colère de Donald Trump ?
Google, évidemment, s'est élevé contre cette décision, en critiquant le DMA au passage. « Pour nous y conformer, nous sommes obligés de retirer des fonctionnalités de recherche en temps réel que les Européens apprécient, comme l'affichage des prix instantanés et la disponibilité directe des hôtels, des vols et des restaurants, et de démanteler des protections en matière de sécurité sur Google Play » a affirmé le président des affaires mondiales de Google, Kent Walker.
Il faut aussi noter que cette décision arrive alors que, la semaine dernière, 25 parlementaires républicains ont adressé une lettre à Donald Trump lui demandant de prendre des mesures contre l'Union européenne, si « des lois, politiques ou pratiques discriminatoires dans le secteur numérique » (comme le DMA) continuaient à être utilisées contre les géants américains. Alors, quelle sera la réaction du président américain, dont on connaît la détestation des règlements européens ?

articles.title: AMD Advancing AI 2026: Ryzen AI Embedded X100, Kria AI Robotics Platform, and Robotics Partner Network
articles.text:
Thursday, July 23rd 2026
	
		
	
	
	AMD Advancing AI 2026: Ryzen AI Embedded X100, Kria AI Robotics Platform, and Robotics Partner Network
At the Advancing AI 2026 event, AMD announced its first entry into "physical AI," a category that covers robotics, industrial automation, and other real-time embedded systems. The company announced new embedded silicon, a turnkey robotics platform, and an open partner ecosystem. These announcements come as three interconnected components: the new Ryzen AI Embedded X100 Series processors, the Kria AI system-on-module and Robotics Developer Platform, and the AMD Robotics Partner Network.
The Ryzen AI Embedded X100 series of processors are AMD's Strix Halo-class silicon, featuring Zen 5 CPU, RDNA 3.5 graphics, and XDNA 2 NPU. These processors are tuned for embedded and robotics applications. AMD projects that the physical AI silicon market will reach $200 billion by 2035 and is positioning its heterogeneous CPU, GPU, NPU, and FPGA portfolio to enhance robotics capabilities "from the robot body to the robot brain." The on-board FPGA can be used to implement low-latency, application-specific functions for mission-critical environments.Ryzen AI Embedded X100 Series
The X100 Series is a single embedded SoC that combines up to 16 high-performance "Zen 5" CPU cores, a discrete-class integrated GPU with up to 40 RDNA 3.5 compute units, and a power-efficient XDNA 2 NPU. AMD integrates these components with a unified memory architecture for low-latency, deterministic operation. It's designed for use in robotics, industrial automation, healthcare, aerospace, and defense, with an operating range of -40 to 105°C and 24/7 operation for up to 10 years. AMD claims performance targets that surpass the Intel Core Ultra Series 3 and NVIDIA Jetson T500 by up to three times in applications such as medical ultrasound beamforming. Customer sampling began in June 2026, with production expected in Q4 2026. Launch partners for system-on-modules include Arbor, Congatec, iBase, IEI, Sapphire, and Seavo.Kria AI System-on-Module

articles.title: 'It's very difficult to predict' — Pompeii: Out of Time survival psychologist on the impact of AI and the one technology disaster we should be more afraid of
articles.text:
I asked a disaster survival psychologist if AI usage should be the same level of 'emergency' as Pompeii — but instead she's worried about a technology catastrophe that I didn't even consider
Dr. Sarita Robinson appears in Pompeii: Out of Time
My favorite interviews over the course of my career have involve people I'd never normally get the chance to speak to in everyday life.
So far this year that's involved two former FBI agents, but Dr. Sarita Robinson — who you can see in Pompeii: Out of Time, out now on Disney+ and Hulu — might just take the cake. Known as "Dr. Survival," her work specialises in figuring out why some people are more likely to survive disasters than others.
This makes her a compelling expert for the three-part docuseries, which explores the events leading up to the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79AD, which destroyed the nearby Roman city of Pompeii, and features Tom Hiddleston as presenter.
But it's not her take on the past that I'm actually as interested in... it's her take on the disasters of the future. As a TechRadar writer, I can't pass up an opportunity to talk to Robinson about the dangers of the rise of AI usage across the globe.
While some of us happily wile away the hours asking ChatGPT to generate images of us as hot dogs, others are getting concerned about increasingly awry security reports, such as Open AI models breaching rival company, Hugging Face.
Add in potential climate change risk, and I think that AI is more than a viable candidate for the sort of survival emergencies that Robinson researches. But surprisingly, AI isn't what she's most worried about.
'We theoretically have a risk from AI'
First, I begin by asking Robinson exactly how she defines a survival emergency. Does it have to be a natural occurrence, like the Mount Vesuvius eruption near Pompeii?
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
"Absolutely not," she replies. "For me, when I'm looking at emergencies, it's anything where your life is at risk. That can be as simple as you walking across a road and a car coming, small scale emergencies that are just enough that you have to respond, or it can be huge emergencies. The last one that I did quite a lot of research on, as you might expect, is the pandemic. The next one will be climate change, the era of global boiling."
"Medium scale would be an earthquake in a region, a terror attack — so they can be human made disasters... they don't have to be just natural disasters."
So far, so good. When it comes to categorizing AI within Robinson's research boundaries, is this kind of technological disaster something she's ever considered?
"I think I've watched enough science fiction movies to know that we theoretically have a risk from AI," she tells me. "Exactly what that risk would be or how it would look is very difficult to predict at this moment. But yes, absolutely, I would definitely add it onto my list of things that can go wrong... my list is quite extensive."
'I would be far more worried about a solar pulse'
"To be fair, I think the thing I worry about more on the tech front is something like a solar pulse that then knocks out a whole load of technology," Robinson adds. "I can't imagine my life without a mobile phone, a computer... it would be very odd to go into an age of no internet."
It's at this point of the interview where I stop feeling bad for adding a disaster scenario to Robinson's list, as she's certainly just added one to mine. Before this point, I'd never even heard of a solar pulse, which can best be described as a sudden burst of energy from the sun. According to the University of Minnesota, they can trigger "explosive releases of radiation and magnetized plasma ripple through space, occasionally triggering geomagnetic storms on Earth and producing auroras."
Fantastic, another reason to have anxiety in 2026. But what is Robinson's advice for not feeling so anxious about... well, general impending doom?
"Be prepared: active coping, doing something about it, keeping it in perspective, but making sure that you have the resources if something goes wrong," she responds. "I don't mean building a nuclear bunker in your back garden. For example, when the pandemic hit back in 2020, I had a 'pandemic kit' under my sink. I felt like I had a little bit more control in that moment."
"I did some research on the pandemic and what it did show was that those people who'd made some preparations prior to the lockdown were doing much better in terms of mental health, stress, anxiety and depression."
Can we make a solar pulse or anti-AI kit for under our sinks? Most likely not. But that doesn't mean that Robinson's advice should be discarded — control also means vigilance, so keeping a mix of online and offline resources in day-to-day life could be a great way of achieving this.

Jasmine is a Streaming Staff Writer for TechRadar, previously writing for outlets including Radio Times, Yahoo! and Stylist. She specialises in comfort TV shows and movies, ranging from Hallmark's latest tearjerker to Netflix's Virgin River. She's also the person who wrote an obituary for George Cooper Sr. during Young Sheldon Season 7 and still can't watch the funeral episode.

articles.title: Un texte de loi force OpenAI, Anthropic et Google à garder un bouton d'arrêt d'urgence pour couper leurs IA
articles.text:
Un texte de loi force OpenAI, Anthropic et Google à garder un bouton d'arrêt d'urgence pour couper leurs IA
Un bouton d'arrêt d'urgence pour les IA les plus puissantes, voilà ce que deux élus du Congrès étasuniens demandent à inscrire dans la loi. Leur texte exige qu'OpenAI et les autres entreprises l'IA à garder la possibilité d'éteindre leurs modèles d'un claquement de doigt. Le gouvernement prendrait les commandes en cas de danger.
La demande tombe pile quelques jours après une évasion d'IA chez OpenAI lors d'un test de sécurité dont nous parlions dans nos colonnes. C'est dans ce contexte que le 23 juillet 2026, le AI Kill Switch Act a été déposé à la Chambre des représentants.
Un kill switch exigé par une loi bipartisane
Ted Lieu, élu démocrate de Californie, et Nathaniel Moran, élu républicain du Texas, portent ce texte ensemble, entre camps politiques opposés. La loi force les développeurs des IA les plus puissantes à garder la capacité de ralentir, de suspendre ou d'éteindre leurs modèles. Il s'agit d'un des rares textes sur l'IA soutenus par les deux partis au Congrès.
Le dépôt du texte arrive à un moment précis. Et pour cause, deux jours auparavant, OpenAI a évoqué un incident qualifié de "sans précédent". Des agents bâtis sur ses modèles, dont GPT-5.6 Sol, se sont échappés d'un environnement de test. Ces agents ont trouvé une faille et ont attaqué Hugging Face, une plateforme d'hébergement de modèles d'IA. Des données internes et des identifiants ont été compromis lors de l'attaque.
La loi demande une réponse graduée. Le secrétaire à la Sécurité intérieure décide, avec l'appui du ministère du Commerce et du renseignement national. La sanction commence par une restriction des réponses du modèle, puis une coupure des accès et un arrêt des opérations.
L'arrêt complet ne serait qu'en dernier recours. Mais ce n'est pas tout puisque la loi force le signalement de chaque incident et la sauvegarde des preuves techniques. Le texte définit même la "perte de contrôle", soit une action risquée du modèle sans intention du développeur.
Tous les développeurs d'IA ne sont pas concernés. On parle des systèmes entraînés avec plus de 100 millions de dollars de puissance de calcul. Les revenus de l'entreprise autour de ces systèmes dépassent en plus 500 millions de dollars par an. En clair, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic et les autres entreprises qui dominent le marché sont concernés. Les amendes atteignent 20 millions de dollars par non-respect.
Une loi qui met d'accord les deux camps politiques
Les deux élus assument un texte de fermeté. "Les systèmes d'IA puissants sont capables de devenir incontrôlables ou même de résister à une intervention humaine", prévient Ted Lieu. Nathaniel Moran défend une position d'équilibre. "Notre responsabilité est de garantir que les humains gardent la capacité de contrôler la technologie que nous construisons", explique l'élu du Texas.
Le texte a des soutiens solides. Un sondage du AI Policy Institute donne 86 % des électeurs favorables à un kill switch pour les IA, chez les démocrates comme chez les républicains. Le texte compte quatre associations en soutien avec AI Policy Network, Americans for Responsible Innovation, ControlAI et l'Alliance for Secure AI.
Sauf que voilà, le Congrès enterre la plupart des textes sur l'IA depuis des années. Au début du mois de juin 2026, les élus Jay Obernolte et Lori Trahan ont proposé une autre voie avec des audits par des tiers. À la fin de juin 2026, Nathaniel Moran a déposé une loi sur le signalement des incidents d'IA.
La Maison-Blanche suit de près l'incident OpenAI. Michael Kratsios, conseiller technologique du président, a un compte rendu de cet incident entre les mains. Le vote du AI Kill Switch Act n'a aucune date pour le moment.

articles.title: Vous pensez vraiment être protégé en navigation privée ? Ce n’est pas le cas
articles.text:
La navigation privée est souvent perçue comme un bouclier contre les menaces en ligne. Pourtant, elle est loin d’offrir l’anonymat ou la protection que beaucoup lui prêtent. Plutôt que de lui accorder une confiance aveugle, mieux vaut comprendre ce qu’elle apporte réellement… et en particulier ce qu’elle ne protège pas.
La fonction « navigation privée » de votre navigateur internet n’aurait-elle de privé que le nom ? Une question légitime tant les informations à ce sujet semblent contradictoires.
À quoi sert le mode Incognito ou navigation privée ?
En pratique, la navigation privée permet de limiter les traces laissées sur votre appareil. Lorsque vous sélectionnez ce mode, votre navigateur n’enregistre pas certaines données comme l’historique des pages consultées, les cookies, les autorisations accordées aux sites ou encore les informations saisies dans les formulaires.
Mais ce qu’il faut bien comprendre, c’est que la navigation privée ne vous rend pas anonyme. Votre fournisseur d’accès à Internet, votre employeur si vous utilisez un réseau professionnel, ainsi que certains services publicitaires peuvent toujours voir une partie de votre activité en ligne et conserver des informations sur votre passage.
Pourquoi ? Tout simplement parce que la navigation privée ne masque pas votre adresse IP, cet identifiant unique attribué à votre appareil lorsqu’il se connecte à Internet.
En d’autres termes, si vous pensez naviguer incognito ou être en sécurité, ce n’est pas le cas ! La navigation privée protège votre vie privée… uniquement vis-à-vis des autres utilisateurs de votre appareil. Pour réduire davantage le suivi en ligne, il est nécessaire de compléter cette fonctionnalité avec d’autres outils.
Comment naviguer de manière vraiment privée sur Internet ?
Vous l'avez compris, le mode navigation privée ne suffit pas à garantir une véritable confidentialité en ligne. Pour renforcer sa protection, plusieurs solutions existent. Les navigateurs modernes proposent des paramètres pour limiter le pistage. Il est possible de bloquer les cookies tiers, de désactiver certains systèmes de suivi publicitaire ou encore de limiter les autorisations accordées aux sites, comme l’accès à la localisation ou au microphone.
L’utilisation d’un bloqueur de publicités permet également de réduire le nombre de traqueurs intégrés aux pages web. Ces solutions ne permettent toutefois de résoudre qu’une partie du problème. Elles réduisent certaines formes de suivi, mais ne masquent ni votre adresse IP ni les informations visibles par votre fournisseur d’accès à Internet ou par les sites que vous consultez.
Pour profiter d’une véritable confidentialité en ligne, le recours à un VPN constitue l’une des solutions les plus efficaces. En chiffrant votre connexion Internet et en masquant votre adresse IP, il complique le suivi de votre activité en ligne et renforce la confidentialité de vos échanges, notamment lorsque vous utilisez un réseau Wi-Fi public. Et même avec un VPN, il faut rester vigilant, car tous les services ne se valent pas.
Certains services gratuits peuvent sembler séduisants à première vue, mais il y a souvent une contrepartie. Pour se financer, des VPN conservent des journaux de connexion ou exploitent certaines données de leurs utilisateurs. Avant de faire votre choix, mieux vaut donc privilégier un service fiable, transparent sur sa politique de confidentialité et qui s’engage à ne pas conserver votre activité en ligne.
Quel VPN choisir pour naviguer sereinement ?
Le premier réflexe à avoir au moment de choisir un VPN est de vérifier sa politique de confidentialité. Un bon service doit s’engager à ne pas conserver de journaux d’activité (« no-log »), afin que vos données de navigation ne soient pas enregistrées.
Un VPN qui joue la carte de la transparence
Proton VPN affiche une politique de non-conservation des logs. Qui plus est, il fait auditer ses infrastructures par des organismes indépendants.Et les résultats sont accessibles au public, sans qu’il soit nécessaire d’être abonné, contrairement à certains services qui réservent ces informations à leurs utilisateurs.
Cette transparence est un gage de confiance, chacun peut vérifier les engagements du service et mieux comprendre la manière dont ses données sont protégées.
Un VPN avec une connexion chiffrée qui protège les données
Il faut également s’assurer que le VPN offre une connexion réellement sécurisée avec un chiffrement robuste des données.
C’est un point crucial pour protéger vos informations personnelles. Proton VPN propose justement ce niveau de protection en faisant circuler le transit internet par un serveur sécurisé qui s’occupe de masquer l’adresse IP et de chiffrer les données. De plus, vous disposez de plus de 20 000 serveurs répartis dans plus de 140 pays.
Un VPN qui assure une navigation sereine au quotidien
Et puis, il y a les fonctionnalités qui viennent enrichir l’expérience au quotidien. Proton VPN propose notamment NetShield, un outil capable de bloquer les publicités intrusives et certains traqueurs potentiellement dangereux, afin de rendre la navigation plus agréable et plus privée.
Autre atout, sa compatibilité. Le service peut être utilisé sur de nombreux appareils, des ordinateurs aux téléviseurs connectés, en passant par les smartphones Android et iOS. Un seul abonnement permet ainsi de protéger jusqu’à 10 appareils selon l’offre sélectionnée.
Cette offre Proton VPN vaut le détour : seulement 2,99 €/mois
- storage20396 serveurs
- language148 pays couverts
- lan10 connexions simultanées
- moodEssai gratuit 30 jours
- thumb_upAvantage : confidentialité renforcée
Proton VPN reste l’un des services les plus cohérents du marché pour qui place la confidentialité au premier plan. Le fournisseur suisse combine des applications bien finies, un excellent VPN gratuit, des outils solides contre la censure et une infrastructure pensée avec un vrai souci de transparence. Les performances tiennent bien la route, surtout sur les localisations proches, et l’ensemble inspire confiance. Le service reste en revanche un peu plus cher que plusieurs concurrents grand public, avec un support encore inégal selon l’urgence des demandes.

articles.title: Top histórico: los 15 videojuegos imprescindibles según los expertos
articles.text:
La selección de los mejores videojuegos de todos los tiempos suele generar debates apasionados y listas que, con frecuencia, repiten los mismos nombres. La revista GQ Magazine propuso un enfoque distinto: en vez de limitarse a la opinión exclusiva de periodistas, convocó a 300 miembros de la industria del videojuego —desarrolladores, escritores, diseñadores, streamers y periodistas— para votar por sus títulos favoritos.
Cada participante presentó su propia lista de 10, otorgando más puntos a los juegos mejor posicionados. El resultado fue un ranking que refleja tanto el peso de la historia como la influencia de nuevas generaciones, combinando éxitos de ventas, obras de culto y propuestas indies en una mezcla de géneros y estilos.
PUBLICIDAD
15. Red Dead Redemption 2 (2018) Rockstar Games // PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One
Rockstar elevó el estándar de los mundos abiertos con una historia intensa, marcada por el destino y la redención. El nivel de detalle técnico es asombroso, desde la animación de los caballos hasta las acciones cotidianas. Cada partida ofrece una experiencia inmersiva y cinematográfica.
14. Super Mario World (1990) Nintendo // SNES
Este clásico de plataformas acompañó el lanzamiento de la SNES y presentó a Yoshi, el carismático dinosaurio. Su diseño de niveles, la jugabilidad fluida y la banda sonora lo volvieron icónico. Sigue siendo el referente indiscutido del género.
PUBLICIDAD
13. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) Nintendo // N64
La aventura de Link en Hyrule definió la narrativa y el diseño de puzles en tres dimensiones. Su atmósfera mítica y la recordada “Song Of Time” marcaron generaciones de jugadores. Durante años, fue el número uno en las listas de mejores juegos.
12. Disco Elysium (2019) ZA/UM // PC
Este innovador RPG pone el foco en el diálogo y la introspección, dando voz a las propias contradicciones del protagonista. El jugador investiga un crimen bajo una resaca monumental en una ciudad decadente. Su profundidad psicológica y narrativa lo hacen único.
PUBLICIDAD
11. Resident Evil 4 (2005) Capcom // GameCube
Shinji Mikami revolucionó la acción en tercera persona y el género de terror con un ritmo vibrante y tensión constante. La cámara sobre el hombro influyó en innumerables títulos posteriores. El reciente remake comprobó que su vigencia sigue intacta.
10. Half-Life 2 (2004) Valve // PC
Half-Life 2 transformó la física y el diseño de entornos en el género de acción. La narrativa se integra magistralmente en la jugabilidad, haciendo cada avance memorable. Su legado se percibe en la mayoría de shooters modernos.
PUBLICIDAD
9. Dark Souls (2011) From Software // PlayStation 3, Xbox 360
Famoso por su dificultad extrema y ambientación opresiva, exige perseverancia y aprendizaje constante. Blighttown y otros escenarios hostiles ponen a prueba tanto la paciencia como la habilidad. Cada victoria ofrece una sensación genuina de logro.
8. Portal 2 (2011) Valve // PC, Mac, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360
Portal 2 combina acertijos ingeniosos basados en portales y física con un guion cargado de humor. La actuación de Stephen Merchant aporta carisma y dinamismo al juego. Es considerado un clásico moderno por su creatividad y ritmo.
PUBLICIDAD
7. Metal Gear Solid (1998) Konami // PlayStation
Este pionero del sigilo consagró a Hideo Kojima como uno de los grandes autores del medio. Su trama compleja y mecánicas innovadoras sentaron las bases del género para futuras generaciones. El enfoque cinematográfico redefinió la narrativa en videojuegos.
6. Mass Effect 2 Bioware // PC, Xbox 360
La epopeya espacial de Bioware ofrece una experiencia donde cada decisión afecta el destino de los personajes. La “Suicide Mission” es uno de los momentos más intensos y recordados del género. El equilibrio entre drama, acción y relaciones define su éxito.
PUBLICIDAD
5. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (2015) CD Projekt Red // PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One
Con un mundo abierto vasto y detallado, The Witcher 3 brilla por sus personajes complejos y misiones profundas. La narrativa adulta y la riqueza de su universo lo han convertido en un referente del rol moderno. Cada historia secundaria es memorable.
4. Bloodborne (2015) From Software // PlayStation 4
Bloodborne destaca por su acción acelerada y una atmósfera oscura inspirada en Lovecraft. Sin secuelas ni derivados, su universo misterioso y desafiante es único. La exigencia y originalidad lo distinguen en el catálogo de From Software.
PUBLICIDAD

La simplicidad de sus mecánicas y su carácter adictivo lo hicieron universalmente reconocible. Ha estado presente en más de 65 plataformas oficiales, cruzando generaciones y mercados. Es un icono indiscutible del diseño de videojuegos.
2. The Last of Us (2013) Naughty Dog // PlayStation 3
The Last of Us se centra en la relación entre un adulto y una adolescente en un mundo devastado. Su narrativa emotiva y su impacto se extendieron al cine y la televisión. Con 32 millones de copias vendidas, redefine el estándar del drama interactivo.
PUBLICIDAD

Breath of the Wild revolucionó los mundos abiertos con libertad total y posibilidades infinitas de exploración. Sus mecánicas sistémicas permiten experimentar y descubrir a cada paso. Marcó un nuevo estándar para la industria y la saga.

articles.title: AMD Advancing AI 2026: Pensando "Salina" DPU and "Vulcano" AI NIC Power Helios Networking
articles.text:
Thursday, July 23rd 2026
	
		
	
	
	AMD Advancing AI 2026: Pensando "Salina" DPU and "Vulcano" AI NIC Power Helios Networking
Networking is the third pillar of AMD's Advancing AI 2026 rack-scale strategy, and today the company detailed the AMD Pensando silicon and fabric technology that connects the Helios rack. As Helios is AMD's first rack-scale design, the company encountered challenges in interconnecting many GPUs, memories, and data movement speeds within a single system, both for scaling up and scaling out for multi-rack connections inside the data center. Current AI infrastructure must closely follow model development as AI model sizes have grown exponentially, from the original 65-million-parameter Transformer in 2017 to trillion-parameter GPT-4-class systems and now 10-trillion-plus parameter agentic and reasoning models. To run a model with more than 10 trillion parameters, you need to connect dozens of GPUs with high-speed VRAM, as well as a high-speed interconnect to split model weights effectively so latency isn't an issue. The modern interconnect of choice is again the plain-old Ethernet, not proprietary interconnects, which have become the standard for AI networking.
AMD's solution spans three layers: a third-generation Pensando "Salina" DPU on the front end, a first-generation UALink-over-Ethernet (UALoE) scale-up fabric inside the rack, and a second-generation Pensando "Vulcano" AI NIC for scale-out. All of this is managed by AMD's Helios management software and Fabric Manager. AMD outlined challenges that bandwidth needs are doubling in less than two years driven by massive AI models growing at a rapid pace, and that the hardware iteration cycles need to account for intelligence in the data fabric layer, not only compute layer.3rd Gen Pensando "Salina" DPU (Front-End)The Salina DPU manages front-end networking at 400G, providing wire-rate concurrent acceleration for security, network, and storage services. AMD claims it offers twice the performance of its previous-generation "Elba" DPU and positions Salina as the only third-party DPU deployed at multiple hyperscalers, including Oracle and Microsoft. While only these two companies have been named, others may also be involved. Additional claims include 1.4 times the performance of NVIDIA's BlueField 3 as a network gateway and support for over 1 million extended-context storage with KV cache to enhance agent density. Microsoft's workloads reported a saving of 22 CPU cores by offloading accelerated connections. These 22 CPU cores are now available to handle other tasks, no longer burdened with smart packet routing.
1st Gen UALoE Scale-Up FabricOne of the most interesting aspects of the rack is how AMD interconnects its GPUs. AMD uses UALink over Ethernet (UALoE) to connect 72 GPUs into a single scale-up domain, providing 260 TB/s of bandwidth and a unified memory pool of 31 TB of HBM4. This configuration turns the entire rack into a single large GPU, allowing AI models to be deployed seamlessly for inference or enabling the interconnection of multiple racks for AI model training. AMD claims that their open-systems approach (ESUN/Ethernet), highly resilient fabric, and Confidential Computing with wire-rate encryption facilitate development. Orchestration is managed by AMD Fabric Manager, which offers software-defined virtual PODs, zero-touch automation, and fabric-wide observability for isolated failure domains. Even if parts of the system fail, the entire system remains operational.
2nd Gen Pensando "Vulcano" AI NIC (Scale-Out)For scale-out fabric that connects multiple racks, AMD uses its second-generation, fully programmable "Vulcano" AI NIC, which operates at 800G with 2.4 Tbps per GPU (three AI NICs per GPU) over PCIe Gen 6 and supports UAL/UEC. AMD claims its custom solution delivers 50% higher scale-out bandwidth than competing solutions and about a 13% increase in LLM training, achieved through intelligent packet routing to minimize latency and losses. By opting for a custom solution instead of an off-the-shelf option like the one from Broadcom, AMD reduced its scale-out costs by a third. For example, the company compared a 32,000 GPU data center running the custom "Vulcano" AI NIC to a 1.6T Broadcom Tomahawk 6 platform for scale-out. The custom solution is not only more performant but also much more cost-efficient, allowing the end customer to redirect those funds into more GPUs and additional compute infrastructure.
Vulcano supports UEC, MRC, and custom transports, and AMD highlights modeling on an 8,000-GPU MI455X cluster, which shows faster time-to-solution when moving from two to three Vulcano NICs per GPU.

articles.title: Instagram promete derrubar vídeos de assédio gravados com óculos da Meta • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Instagram promete derrubar vídeos de assédio gravados com óculos da Meta
Conteúdos produzidos em lugares públicos envolvendo pegadinhas e cantadas não serão tolerados, afirma Adam Mosseri, que comanda a rede social.
Resumo
- Instagram não permitirá mais vídeos que mostrem assédio ou constrangimento a estranhos em locais públicos.
- Esses vídeos, populares em redes sociais, mostram pessoas sendo filmadas sorrateiramente em situações como cantadas ou pegadinhas.
- A Meta afirmou trabalha para impedir alterações nos LEDs indicadores de gravação dos óculos inteligentes.
Adam Mosseri, chefe do Instagram, anunciou que o Instagram não vai mais permitir vídeos constrangendo ou assediando estranhos em lugares públicos. Parte considerável desse conteúdo é feita com os óculos inteligentes da Meta.
“Se você postar conteúdos tirando vantagem de pessoas ou as assediando, como um monte desses vídeos de cantadas que vimos, então vamos derrubar o conteúdo”, afirmou o executivo em um story publicado na rede social. “Não queremos que as pessoas gravem vídeos de outras pessoas sorrateiramente, cometendo assédios e postando na nossa plataforma. Vamos comprar essa briga de todos os jeitos”, completou.
Como são os vídeos que a Meta quer derrubar?
Como nota o Business Insider, vídeos com pegadinhas envolvendo trabalhadores como caixas e atendentes vêm se tornando populares no TikTok e nos reels do Instagram. Em muitos casos, eles são constrangedores ou envolvem provocações. Outro tipo de conteúdo em alta é dar cantadas em mulheres na academia ou na rua, sem dizer que elas estão sendo filmadas.
A publicação notou ainda que duas páginas do gênero foram desativadas. Ambas contavam com mais de um milhão de seguidores cada.
A Meta confirmou que se trata de uma medida ativa da companhia: as contas violaram a política relativa a postar conteúdo de assédio gravado usando óculos inteligentes.
Mesmo assim, a empresa não disse quantos vídeos já foram derrubados com base nessa política. Ela também não explicou como será feita a fiscalização desse tipo de conteúdo e o que constituiria uma violação das regras.
Prática vira problema para fabricantes
Os diferentes modelos de óculos smart da Meta têm um LED que acende quando uma gravação está sendo feita. É uma forma de informar as pessoas ao redor que elas estão sendo filmadas.
No entanto, surgiram vários métodos para burlar esse mecanismo, como adulterar o LED, fazer um buraco ou mesmo cobri-lo. A Meta diz que uma atualização vai desativar a câmera caso o LED sofra uma alteração.
Com tantos vídeos desagradáveis, algumas pessoas passaram a chamar os dispositivos da Meta de “óculos de pervertido”. Impedir que esse tipo de conteúdo se dissemine não deixa de ser uma forma de proteger a reputação do produto.
O uso inadequado dos óculos se tornou um problema até para quem ainda não chegou ao mercado. Nesta semana, a Samsung deu mais detalhes sobre seus óculos smart feitos em parceria com o Google e enfatizou que vai trabalhar de forma proativa para impedir que os LEDs indicadores de gravação sejam desativados.
Com informações do Business Insider e do Engadget.

articles.title: I looked at Josh Kerr’s Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro data from his world-record mile — and his lap splits explain how he broke the 27-year-old mark
articles.text:
Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro data reveals how Josh Kerr just shattered the 27-year-old mile world record — and his split stats explain the historic run
It’s all in the consistency
- Athlete Josh Kerr just broke the world record mile time
- He did so while wearing an Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro smartwatch
- Amazfit has published data from the record-breaking run
What does it take to run a mile in a world record time? After Scottish athlete Josh Kerr’s recent world record-shattering 3:42.66 achievement, Amazfit has published a wealth of data straight from the track — and there are some fascinating insights to be found within.
Perhaps the most impressive data point to emerge from Kerr’s race, logged on a Cheetah 2 Pro, is the remarkable consistency in his split times. His four laps clocked in at 55.3, 55.8, 55.4 and 54.9 seconds, with just 0.9 seconds separating the fastest lap from the slowest. His quickest lap, in fact, was the last one, helping to push him over the line and claim the world record, which had previously stood for 27 years.
Even more striking were Kerr’s 200-meter times, which ranged from 24.7 to 24.9 seconds — a difference of just 0.5 seconds from first to last. With an average speed of 26km/h, he was comfortably quicker than the 24.1km/h required to hit a four-minute mile.
Kerr averaged 194 steps per minute during the race, with his heart rate hitting a maximum of 188 beats per minute around 400 meters in. In both cases, the measurements rose sharply early in the run, settled in the middle, then jumped again as Kerr pushed for a fast finish.
Project 222
The info comes from the Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro that Kerr wore during his winning race.
We were impressed with this device when we reviewed it, commending its accurate features and “outstanding battery,” both of which help make it one of the best running watches money can buy. And if it’s good enough for world record holders like Kerr, it could be worth a place on your wrist, too.
The previous one-mile record — set by Hicham El Guerrouj and standing at 3:43.13 — had stood for 27 years before Kerr broke it, making him the first person to ever log a mile in under three minutes and 43 seconds.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Amazfit has been sponsoring Kerr as part of his Project 222, which is a bid to run a mile in 222 seconds, or three minutes and 42 seconds. Kerr’s record time is just 0.66 seconds off that target, showing how close he was to his goal.
How long will it be before he speeds past that time? No one can know, but you’d be brave to bet against him doing it, and Amazfit will be hoping he's wearing one its running watches again when that happens.

articles.title: Quién le da voz a Huntrix, qué canciones aparecen en Las guerreras K-pop y más preguntas de Google
articles.text:
Las Guerreras K-pop es la película animada más popular de Netflix. La protagoniza el grupo ficticio de pop coreano Huntrix, cuyos tres personajes son Rumi, Mira y Zoey.
En la versión en inglés, el reparto de voces se divide entre actuación hablada y canto:
- Rumi (la líder): voz hablada por Arden Cho, actriz de Teen Wolf, y voz cantada por EJAE.
- Mira: voz hablada por May Hong y voz cantada por Audrey Nuna.
- Zoey: voz hablada por Ji-young Yoo y voz cantada por Rei Ami.
En el doblaje para España, Blanca Hualde —conocida como Neri— presta su voz a Rumi, Claudia Caneda a Zoey y Lourdes Montes a Mira.
En la versión latinoamericana, Azul Bötticher —quien también interpreta los temas cantados del personaje—, Tatul Bernodat y Karin Zavala asumen los tres roles.
A pesar de que la película ya cumplió un año de su estreno, a Google todavía acuden los fanáticos a realizar consultas sobre el título de Netflix y Sony.
PUBLICIDAD
A continuación, recopilación de las preguntas más frecuentes de Google con sus respuestas.
Qué canciones aparecen en Las guerreras K-pop
Las canciones que aparecen en Las guerreras K-pop son:
- Golden de Huntrix (ganó un premio Oscar por mejor canción original) .
- How It’s Done de Huntrix.
- Takedown de Huntrix
- Strategy de Twice.
- Soda Pop del otro grupo ficticio Saja Boys.
- Your Idol de Saja Boys.
Qué tan cierto es que Las guerreras K-pop tendrán secuela
Es totalmente cierto que Las guerreras K-pop tendrán una secuela. Esto ya lo confirmó Netflix.
“Como cineasta coreana, me siento muy orgullosa de que el público quiera más de esta historia coreana y de nuestros personajes coreanos. Hay mucho más en este mundo que hemos construido y me emociona poder mostrarlo. Este es sólo el principio”, dijo Maggie Kang, guionista y directora de la película.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué premios Oscar ganó la película Las guerreras K-pop
Las Guerreras K-pop ganó dos premios Oscar en la 98ª entrega de los Premios de la Academia, celebrada el 15 de marzo de 2026:
- Mejor Película Animada.
- Mejor Canción Original por Golden.
Golden se convirtió en la primera canción de K-pop en ganar un Oscar. Durante la ceremonia, las voces cantantes del grupo ficticio HUNTR/X (EJAE, Audrey Nuna y Rei Ami) interpretaron el tema en vivo mientras el público agitaba light sticks en la sala.
PUBLICIDAD
Los directores Maggie Kang y Chris Appelhans, junto a la productora Michelle L.M. Wong, recibieron el galardón a Mejor Película Animada. Kang, de ascendencia coreana, hizo historia como la primera persona de ese origen en ganar en esa categoría.
Las guerreras K-pop en Google
El fenómeno de Las Guerreras K-pop también se manifestó en Google. Según el informe El año en búsquedas 2025 del buscador, la película fue la más buscada del año, tres de sus canciones integraron el Top 10 anual y el título ocupó el segundo puesto en tendencias generales.
PUBLICIDAD
Google Trends, por su parte, registró que los personajes de la película coparon los cinco primeros lugares entre los disfraces de Halloween más buscados de 2025.
El éxito se trasladó a la música con igual fuerza. La banda sonora oficial permaneció dos semanas en el primer puesto del Billboard 200, superó los 15.000 millones de reproducciones en todo el mundo y se posicionó como la banda sonora más escuchada de la década.
PUBLICIDAD
Impulsadas por los fans, las canciones se agregaron a más de 17.000 listas de reproducción, mientras que los temas de los grupos ficticios HUNTR/X y Saja Boys superaron en conjunto los 1.000 millones de reproducciones en Spotify y YouTube.
Golden se mantuvo 18 semanas en el primer lugar del Billboard Global 200, igualando el récord de permanencia en la cima de esa lista, y lideró durante ocho semanas el Billboard Hot 100.
PUBLICIDAD
Con ese desempeño, se convirtió en la primera canción de un grupo femenino de K-pop en alcanzar ese puesto y en el número uno más longevo de un grupo femenino en lo que va del siglo.
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: AMD Instinct MI400 Series and Helios Rack Debut: CDNA 5 Goes 2 nm, Plus ROCm.ai and "Gorgon Halo"
articles.text:
Thursday, July 23rd 2026
	
		
	
	
	AMD Instinct MI400 Series and Helios Rack Debut: CDNA 5 Goes 2 nm, Plus ROCm.ai and "Gorgon Halo"
AMD used its Advancing AI 2026 keynote today to launch the Instinct MI400 Series, its next-generation data-center GPU family, alongside the Helios rack-scale solution and the CDNA 5 architecture that underpins both. CDNA 5 is AMD's first GPU architecture to reach the 2 nm node, with the flagship Instinct MI455X carrying 320 billion transistors across a multi-chiplet package and 432 GB of HBM4. This is a data-center compute architecture, not a Radeon gaming architecture, though some of the design choices in CDNA 5 point to where AMD's future unified gaming/compute architecture could be headed.
The MI400 Series splits into two parts: the Instinct MI455X for frontier AI and AI-factory deployments, and the Instinct MI430X for sovereign AI and HPC. Together with the Helios rack, 6th Gen EPYC "Venice" CPUs and AMD Pensando networking, they form AMD's open answer to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72. This post also covers the new ROCm.ai software stack and AMD's "Gorgon Halo" client teaser.Instinct MI455X: CDNA 5 on 2 nm
The MI455X is AMD's first GPU designed from the ground up for rack-scale deployment. AMD moves the compute (XCD) chiplets to TSMC's N2 process—2 nm gate-all-around—while the FCD and MID chiplets use the N3P (3 nm FinFET) process. The package integrates 8 XCD, 2 IOD and 2 FCD dies alongside 12 stacks of HBM4, for a total of 320 billion transistors. Key specs:
AMD attributes the MI455X's efficiency gains to a broad set of architectural changes: larger caches, multicast memory operations, Tensor Data Mover enhancements, Wave32 execution, HBM4 memory, and the UALoE scale-up fabric—all aimed at reducing data movement and overhead per unit of useful work. The whole design is oriented around the 72-GPU shared-memory pod (see Helios below), rather than the traditional 8-GPU node, which is a first for AMD Instinct.
Not a Gaming Architecture
CDNA is AMD's data-center compute line; RDNA remains the gaming graphics architecture (the current Radeon parts are RDNA 4, and there is no consumer Radeon news at this event). However, AMD has publicly stated it intends to converge CDNA and RDNA into a single unified architecture ("UDNA") in the future—so CDNA 5's choices are a useful tell. The most eye-catching is Wave32 execution: a 32-wide wavefront model that has been an RDNA hallmark, now appearing in CDNA. AMD's continued investment in block-scaled low-precision data types (MXFP4/FP6/FP8) is also relevant, since on-GPU low-precision AI math is exactly what future gaming GPUs will lean on for upscaling, frame generation and on-device AI. Add the maturing chiplet packaging and the move to 2 nm, and CDNA 5 shows the building blocks a future unified gaming/compute architecture would inherit. None of this makes CDNA 5 a gaming part, but it's a clear look at the common technology base.
Instinct MI430X: Sovereign AI and HPC
The MI430X targets sovereign AI, national infrastructure, research institutions and leadership-class HPC, where numerical accuracy matters. AMD quotes up to 288 TFLOPS of hardware-based FP64 performance for scientific computing, deployed in traditional mesh-based HPC topologies rather than the Helios rack. It shares the MI400 Series' HBM4 memory, advanced security (secure boot, encrypted GPU-to-GPU links) and open ROCm software foundation.AMD Helios: The Rack-Scale Solution
Helios is AMD's open, validated rack-scale blueprint: 72 MI455X GPUs across 18 open-rack, four-GPU compute trays, paired with EPYC 9006 SP7 "Venice" CPUs and AMD Pensando networking. Per rack, AMD quotes:
ROCm.ai: AI-Native Software Stack
Alongside the hardware, AMD announced ROCm.ai, an AI-native developer experience that bundles several pieces:
"Gorgon Halo" and the Ryzen AI Mini-PC Successor
For readers watching the client side, AMD teased "Gorgon Halo," the successor to its Strix Halo / Ryzen AI MAX platform—the silicon behind the current wave of compact AI mini-PC "boxes." AMD says it extends unified memory from 128 GB up to 192 GB and pushes local model support from 200B up to 300B parameters, letting these desktop-class systems run cloud-scale models locally. AMD also referenced its next-gen Ryzen AI 400 mobile series, deepened its Hugging Face partnership (native "Halo" support plus a year of Hugging Face Pro bundled with every Halo box), and a Cisco partnership for secured deskside AI. It shows how AMD's AI data-center technology is trickling down into prosumer and enthusiast desktops.

articles.title: Amazon brade cette batterie externe de 10 000 mAh et lui offre un prix qui frôle les dix euros
articles.text:
Avec une capacité de 10 000 mAh et une puissance de 15 W, cette batterie externe est une Power Bank d'appoint qui pourra dépanner en cas d'urgence. À défaut de convaincre par sa fiche technique, elle se démarque par son prix dépassant légèrement les dix euros.
La batterie externe Belkin 10 000 mAh à 10,22 € au lieu de 29,99 €
Pourquoi choisir la batterie externe de Belkin ?
- Trois ports de charge et un câble inclus : Cette batterie externe se présente avec deux ports de charge USB-C et un port USB-A. Par ailleurs, un câble USB-C vers USB-A est fourni.
- Compatible avec la recharge rapide : Avec 10 000 mAh, on ne peut pas dire que cette batterie soit endurante. Cependant, elle s'avère diablement efficace et vous pouvez récupérer plusieurs heures d'autonomie avec une bonne dizaine de minutes de charge.
- Le prix : Avec son prix de dix euros, cette batterie externe n'est pas un grand investissement. Pour ce qu'elle propose, l'offre d'Amazon s'avère très intéressante.
Jusqu'à trois appareils simultanément
La capacité contenue de cette batterie de Belkin s'explique d'abord par son format. Seulement 211 grammes sur la balance pour à peine trois centimètres d'épaisseur et 11 cm de longueur. Pour être plus précis, elle est moins longue que la plupart des smartphones récents. Par conséquent, elle pourra facilement se glisser dans une poche.
Pour son design, Belkin ne fait pas de folie et propose un produit entièrement noir. Pour la recharge, il y a trois ports (deux USB-C et un USB-A) et un câble USB-C vers USB-A est fourni. Ainsi, trois appareils pourront être connectés simultanément. Une protection anti-surcharge est présente et quatre petites diodes lumineuses sur le côté indiquent le niveau d'autonomie restant.

articles.title: Asus et MSI dans les starting-blocks pour inaugurer la puce Nvidia RTX Spark
articles.text:
Asus et MSI dans les starting-blocks pour inaugurer la puce Nvidia RTX Spark
L'écosystème Windows s'apprête à accueillir une nouvelle génération de PC dédiés à l'intelligence artificielle locale. Plusieurs constructeurs préparent le lancement de leurs premiers modèles équipés de la plateforme Nvidia RTX Spark.
La puce RTX Spark réunit un processeur logique ARM Nvidia Grace de 20 cœurs et un processeur graphique Nvidia Blackwell doté de 6 144 cœurs CUDA. L'ensemble propose jusqu'à 1 PFLOPS de puissance de calcul IA en FP4 et s'appuie sur une architecture de mémoire unifiée pouvant atteindre 128 Go. Cette conception vise à faciliter l'exécution d'agents IA locaux et la gestion de modèles de langage volumineux tout en conservant une efficacité énergétique adaptée à un usage nomade.
Les premiers PC portables dotés de cette puce seront des modèles de chez Asus et MSI. Acer et Gigabyte proposeront leurs propres déclinaisons dans un second temps, bien qu'aucun modèle n'aient été aperçus lors du Computex.
L'offensive d'Asus avec les ProArt P14 et P16
Asus intègre la puce RTX Spark de Nvidia dans deux PC portables à vocation créatrice : les ProArt P14 (H7407) et ProArt P16 (H7607). Le modèle de 14 pouces affiche 13,9 mm d'épaisseur pour 1,48 kg, tandis que la version de 16 pouces mesure 12,9 mm pour 1,77 kg.
Les deux machines adoptent des dalles Oled à rafraîchissement variable pouvant atteindre 120 Hz, offrant une luminosité maximale en pic de 1600 cd/m², un traitement antireflet et promettent un Delta E inférieur à 1. La définition atteint le 3K sur la version 14 pouces et le 4K sur la version 16 pouces.

Celular de 128 GB barato: 9 smartphones para comprar em 2026
Encontre o melhor celular com armazenamento de 128 GB que une boas especificações a um preço baixo; lista inclui smartphones Samsung, Motorola e Xiaomi.
Encontre o melhor celular com armazenamento de 128 GB que une boas especificações a um preço baixo; lista inclui smartphones Samsung, Motorola e Xiaomi.
Os celulares de 128 GB oferecem boa capacidade de armazenamento para que usuários comuns salvem fotos, vídeos e aplicativos essenciais do dia a dia.
Em 2026, já é possível encontrar modelos baratos de marcas como Samsung, Xiaomi e Motorola que entregam essa quantidade de memória interna, além de outros benefícios, como telas de alta definição e bateria de longa duração.
Esta lista reúne 9 opções de smartphones com 128 GB recomendados para quem busca economia, praticidade e especificações equilibradas, para diferentes perfis de uso e orçamento.
O Galaxy A36 é um celular intermediário com bom desempenho devido ao processador Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 e 6 GB de memória RAM, na versão com 128 GB de armazenamento.
Ele tem padrão de memória UFS 2.2, que não tem velocidade de leitura tão rápida quanto o de modelos mais caros, mas entrega uma performance sem travamentos para tarefas cotidianas. Vale destacar que o smartphone não suporta cartões de memória.
Outros destaques são a tela Super AMOLED com taxa de atualização de 120 Hz, que entrega cores vivas, alto contraste e rolagem suave, e o conjunto de câmeras traseiras, com sensor principal de 50 MP e estabilização óptica (OIS), que grava em até 4K a 30 fps.
A Samsung garante ainda 6 anos de atualizações do Android a partir do lançamento – isto é, até 2031.
O Redmi Note 15 é um smartphone intermediário com bom desempenho para mídias sociais, streaming e jogos populares. O modelo de 128 GB acompanha 6 GB de RAM e usa padrão de armazenamento interno UFS 2.2. Também há espaço para cartão microSD.
A câmera traseira tem sensor principal de 108 megapixels com abertura de lente f/1.7 que entrega boas capturas para a faixa de preço. Já em vídeos o smartphone fica limitado a gravações de 1080p a 60 fps.
A bateria é um destaque, com capacidade para 6.000 mAh e carregamento rápido de 33 W.
O Galaxy A17 5G é um celular de entrada que custa menos de R$ 1 mil e é indicado para tarefas básicas, como navegação em redes sociais e troca de mensagens. Ele traz tela grande com tecnologia Super AMOLED e taxa de atualização de 90 Hz, boa para streaming de vídeo.
O smartphone tem 128 GB de armazenamento no padrão UFS 2.2 com a possibilidade de expansão via microSD, o que dá um fôlego extra para quem costuma guardar muitas fotos e vídeos ou acaba baixando muitos aplicativos.
O processador é o Exynos 1330, um dos mais eficientes da categoria, fabricado em 5 nm. Já a bateria tem 5.000 mAh e entrega autonomia satisfatória para um dia de uso moderado longe das tomadas.
O Galaxy A07 5G tem processador básico, com litografia de 6 nm, mas com boa eficiência energética para lidar com chamadas, mensagens e navegação.
O aparelho inclui 128 GB de memória interna no padrão UFS 2.2 para guardar e acessar rapidamente os apps e fotos do dia a dia, além de 4 GB de RAM. Também é possível expandir o armazenamento com cartão microSD.
A tela grande de 6,7 polegadas com tecnologia PLS LCD facilita a visualização de mídias sociais e transmissões, mas as cores são menos intensas e o preto não é tão profundo quanto em telas AMOLED.
Um grande destaque é a bateria de 6.000 mAh, que pode oferecer com folga mais de um dia longe das tomadas em uso comum.
Para quem quer economizar ao máximo, o Galaxy A06 5G entrega praticamente as mesmas especificações de câmeras, tela (com exceção da taxa de atualização), processador e memória do A07 5G por um preço mais baixo.
O sacrifício é visto na bateria – o A06 tem 5.000 mAh e menor autonomia – e na política de atualizações: o A06 5G vai apenas até o Android 19 (2029).
O Redmi 15C 5G é um dos principais celulares Xiaomi com 128 GB baratos em 2026. Ele tem processador relativamente eficiente para o segmento, com litografia de 6 nm, e a memória RAM é de 4 GB de memória RAM, o que se reflete em desempenho básico, mas sem travamentos, para uso cotidiano.
O padrão de memória interna é UFS 2.2 e é possível expandir o armazenamento de 128 GB via cartão microSD.
Mais destaques são: a bateria de 6.000 mAh, que deve entregar boa autonomia para um dia inteiro de uso moderado, sem necessidade de recarga; e o suporte a carregamento rápido de 33 W.
O Poco C85 é um smartphone bem semelhante ao Redmi 15C, com processador MediaTek Dimensity 6300 (6 nm). Entretanto, é mais comumente encontrado com 6 GB de RAM na versão com 128 GB internos, o que proporciona mais fluidez e menos travamentos em multitarefa. O padrão de memória utilizado é UFS 2.2 e há slot dedicado para cartão microSD.
Além disso, o smartphone traz a mesma capacidade de bateria (6.000 mAh) do modelo “irmão”, e suporte a carregamento rápido de 33 W.
O Moto G35 é um celular de entrada da Motorola que entrega boa performance no dia a dia com processador Unisoc T760 (6 nm). A versão de 128 GB internos utiliza o padrão UFS 2.2, e a memória RAM é de 4 GB. O smartphone também traz slot para cartão de memória.
A tela de 6,72” entrega alta resolução apesar de usar tecnologia IPS LCD, que peca mais nos contrastes. Ainda assim, é um painel agradável para consumo de mídia, e o som com selo Dolby Atmos ajuda na imersão.
As câmeras traseiras têm sensores de 50 MP (wide) e 8 MP (ultrawide). São boas para o básico, e um ponto interessante é a gravação de vídeos em até 4K a 30 fps.
Um ponto negativo é que ele foi lançado com Android 14, já está no Android 16, e não deve receber mais atualizações de versão do sistema. Os pacotes de segurança chegam até 2027, de acordo com a política da marca.
A opção mais econômica da Motorola com 128 GB internos é o Moto G06, que tem processador menos eficiente (12 nm) e 4 GB de RAM.
A empresa não especifica o padrão de armazenamento para esse modelo, mas levando em conta o processador MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra, há boas chances de ser padrão eMMC 5.1, que é naturalmente mais lento do que o UFS.
Desse modo, o celular é indicado para tarefas simples do dia a dia, como troca de mensagens e navegação em redes sociais, uma vez que a experiência deve ficar comprometida em apps mais pesados.
A escolha do smartphone exige atenção aos componentes internos do dispositivo, dentre eles:
O armazenamento de 128 GB é adequado para grande parte dos usuários de smartphones. Essa capacidade da memória interna suporta centenas de aplicativos, fotos e vídeos sem comprometer o sistema. No entanto, há outros fatores que determinam se o celular é bom, como processador, RAM, câmeras e capacidade de bateria.
O sistema operacional e as aplicações pré-instaladas ocupam parte do armazenamento do dispositivo. O usuário geralmente encontra entre 100 GB e 112 GB de espaço livre para uso pessoal.
A maioria dos celulares de entrada e intermediários possui slot para cartão microSD. A expansão permite armazenar fotos e mídias no cartão sem lotar a memória principal do celular.
A versão de 256 GB é recomendada para quem grava vídeos em resolução 4K ou instala jogos muito pesados. Quem procura celulares com melhor custo-benefício encontra nas opções de 128 GB o equilíbrio perfeito entre preço e usabilidade.

articles.title: Goodbye SMS or phone calls — Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication process for businesses
articles.text:
Goodbye SMS or phone calls — Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication process for businesses
Passkeys will soon become the Entra ID default
- Beginning September 1, 2026, passkeys will become the default for Entra ID
- Microsoft is retiring SMS/phone call authentication from February 1, 2027
- Victims are more likely to open AI-assisted phishing emails
Microsoft has confirmed plans to make passkeys the default or preferred authentication method for Entra ID beginning September 1, 2026, announcing further changes to account authentication in a bid to combat sophisticated attacks.
A few months later from February 1, 2027, the company will also stop providing its own SMS and voice call authentication codes for Entra ID in the hope that business users fully adopt passwordless sign-in.
While passkeys don't promise to totally stop attacks, they make phishing attempts far less effective because attackers would need access to victims' hardware to gain access.
Microsoft continues its drive for passkeys
While the company may be ending support for its own SMS and phone call authentication methods, passkeys won't be the only sign-in method after the change. Windows Hello for Business (biometrics) and FIDO2 security keys will still be available, for example.
"The AI era demands stronger, phishing-resistant authentication," a company notice seen by Windows Latest reads. "We are making passkeys the default authentication experience in Microsoft Entra to help customers securely adopt AI at scale."
Though AI hasn't exactly made attacks better at breaking through traditional authentication methods, it has made attacks more convincing. According to the company's own information, the click-through rate for phishing emails stands at 54% for AI-assisted campaigns, compared with just 12% for conventional ones.
With more people opening up malicious links, the effects are compounded, hence the push to improve general security.

Looking ahead, Microsoft's suggested plan for impacted organizations includes identifying users who still use SMS/voice authentication, planning a company-wide passkey rollout and keeping workers up-to-date.
"SMS and voice have served their purpose well, bringing multifactor authentication to billions of users who otherwise would have had none," Microsoft concluded, declaring that "the threat environment has evolved beyond their capabilities."

articles.title: AMD EPYC 9006 LP is the Company's Answer to NVIDIA Vera CPU
articles.text:
Thursday, July 23rd 2026
	
		
	
	
	AMD EPYC 9006 LP is the Company's Answer to NVIDIA Vera CPU
AMD EPYC 9006 "Venice-LP" is a purpose-built enterprise processors for rack-scale AI solutions. It is designed with the exact same system philosophy as NVIDIA's Grace and Vera CPUs—to handle serial processing loads and the OS stack for AI GPU servers with bandwidth-heavy network stacks. While NVIDIA uses specialized Arm CPU cores, AMD remains an x86 loyalist, and designed "Venice-LP" around its latest "Zen 6" microarchitecture. 
The CPU side of EPYC 9006 LP consists of a 72-core/144-thread "Zen 6" complex that runs at a boost frequency of up to 5.00 GHz. The processor features a 24-channel LPDDR5X memory interface that supports SOCAMM2 modules. The main interconnect between the processor and AI GPUs is 112 Gbps-per-pin xGMI, along with optimization for AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs that are powered by the CDNA 5 architecture.Unlike the rest of the EPYC 9006 family, the 9006 LP isn't a socketed processor, rather, it is an embedded, BGA package, similar to NVIDIA Vera CPU. The chip has a high-degree of power and thermal optimization specific to the platform it's being designed for.
Although announced today, it won't be until the second half of 2027 that the first systems with EPYC 9006 LP processors will arrive. AMD will build compute nodes with Instinct MI455X CDNA 5 AI GPUs and EPYC 9006 LP processors, along with various configurations of LPDDR5X SOCAMM2 memory.

Avec son Apple Watch Series 10, la marque à la pomme améliorait le design de sa montre connectée avec un écran prenant plus de place sur la façade avant. articles.title: U.S. Starts Genesis Mission with $5B for First Projects - EE Times
articles.text:
The U.S. government on July 21st announced more than $5 billion in funding for the first projects under the national Genesis Mission to accelerate AI. That bet is good for a start, but it falls short of the work China is doing, according to an analyst who commented to EE Times.
The U.S. government initiative, announced in December 2025, aims to boost scientific research through AI. The U.S. and China are months apart in a race for AI leadership, according to many observers. The U.S. has a lead in frontier AI models, talent, and capital deployment, while China pushes ahead with cost-optimized models, according to a report published by the Boston Consulting Group on June 30th.
The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), which oversees much of the U.S. tech portfolio, will fund research teams at Argonne National Laboratory, one of several U.S. laboratories participating in the Genesis Mission. Private companies such as quantum computing startup Infleqtion are also joining the DOE project.
Research teams will help develop and demonstrate AI-enabled scientific workflows to accelerate breakthroughs in energy, discovery science, and national security, the DOE said in a statement released on July 22nd.
“The 278 projects selected today represent the very best of our nation’s scientific enterprise,” Secretary of Energy Chris Wright said in the statement. “America’s innovation pipeline is strong, and it points to even greater opportunities for future investment and continued expansion of the Genesis Mission portfolio.”
The effort announced this week shows how AI can help address complex challenges in energy, national security, and scientific discovery, Temitope Taiwo, director of the Nuclear Science Division at Argonne, said in a prepared statement. “Argonne researchers and their partners will apply AI to areas such as nuclear fuel recycling, quantum technologies, weather and water forecasting, advanced microelectronics, and cybersecurity.”
The largest project so far is a three-year, $60 million investment in nuclear energy that will harness AI to help build nuclear facilities faster and safer while cutting operating costs to provide Americans affordable, reliable, and secure energy, the DOE said.
Small bet
The U.S. probably needs to up the ante backing its Genesis Mission, according to Handel Jones, CEO at International Business Strategies.
“$5 billion is better than nothing, but it should start at $50 billion,” Jones told EE Times. China will earmark $295 billion for its national AI expansion over the next five years, according to media reports.
China has strong advantages in cost and manufacturing, according to Jones.
“Token prices in China are less than 10% those in the U.S.,” Jones said, speaking during a visit to Asia. “Leadership in agentic AI is a national commitment in China. China is already significantly ahead of the U.S. in physical AI such as robots.”
Quantum computing
Infleqtion has three DOE Genesis Mission projects to advance AI-optimized quantum computing, deployable quantum sensing, and fusion energy research. The startup will work with Argonne National Laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, and the University of Colorado Boulder. The work will include AI-optimized quantum circuit design for nuclear applications, deployable atomic quantum sensing with agentic AI, and nuclear fusion energy research.
The boom in construction of AI data centers has stressed the U.S. power grid. New data centers are turning to alternative sources of off-grid power such as natural gas and nuclear energy. Quantum computing is seen as a way of easing AI’s power consumption.
“AI data centers are pulling more power than the grid was ever built to handle, and the industry is recognizing that these types of issues are beyond the capabilities of classical computing alone,” said Infleqtion CEO Matthew Kinsella in a prepared statement. “By applying quantum computing to some of the hardest problems in nuclear and energy research, Infleqtion is playing a critical role in advancing the objectives of the Genesis Mission.”
The SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, working with southern California universities, will lead a Genesis Mission project to help secure the nation’s critical mineral supply by developing AI tools to improve recovery of valuable transition metals from spent lithium-ion batteries.
“Over nine months, SLAC and the University of Southern California will run several AI-experiment cycles, aiming to recover target metals at 80% purity or better, while bench-marking this approach against conventional literature search-and-recovery methods,” Ahamed Irshad Maniyanganam, SLAC associate scientist and lead researcher, said in a statement.
China controls the supply of rare-earth materials that are essential to production of semiconductors and magnets used in everything from jet fighters to smartphones. China’s April 2025 export restrictions on rare earths and permanent magnets have triggered rapid disruptions across defense and industrial supply chains, exposing the fragility of a system still heavily dependent on Beijing, think tank CSIS said in an April 2026 report.
A single spent EV battery holds tens of pounds of valuable metals. The SLAC-led project will use multiple AI agents to propose specific methods for extracting the metals and evaluate them experimentally in a lab. SLAC aims to provide expertise in materials science, chemistry, battery research, and chemical engineering.
In addition to the metals recovery project, SLAC will contribute to 10 Genesis Mission Phase I projects in areas including biotechnology, fusion energy, electronics and sensors, cosmology, particle physics, and accelerator technology.
Ryan Herbst, a division director at SLAC, told EE Times about a joint project led by Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory as part of the Genesis Mission.
“Most of our role there is the extreme environment data because we’ve done a lot of research on operating in cryogenic or high-radiation environments,” Herbst said. “The idea of the overall Access project is using AI to speed up the iterations of filling in models so that you can do the deployment of ASICs in extreme environments and figuring out if we can use AI to fill gaps in the data.”
No money yet
Selection for award negotiations is not a commitment by DOE to issue an award or provide funding, the DOE noted. Before funding is issued, the DOE and applicants will undergo a negotiation process, and DOE may cancel negotiations and rescind the selection for any reason during that process.
Awardees will gain access to the Genesis Mission Platform, including AI agent frameworks, advanced AI models, and software made available through industry partners, as well as high-performance computing resources across the DOE’s national laboratories and partner facilities. Together, these capabilities will enable researchers to rapidly design, test, and refine new approaches, the DOE said. The DOE provided more details at this link.

articles.title: Who needs Dolby Vision 2? LG's latest OLED TVs are getting a 'Creator Original' mode with some of its best features — and Prime Video is on board to support it
articles.text:
LG's latest OLED TVs will have a 'Creator Original' mode that works with Prime Video: it seems to take some of Dolby Vision 2's best features, but may arrive sooner — and unlike DV2, will be supported on LG's TVs…
LG wants you to become a Master of the Universe with its new picture mode
- Filmmaker mode in reverse: Creator Original embraces your TV's processing power
- Initially limited to 2026 C6, G6 and W6 OLED TVs
- Rolling out by the end of July 2026
LG Electronics has partnered with Prime Video to launch a new picture mode in select LG TVs. The new mode, called Creator Original, will initially be exclusive to three 2026 models: the LG C6, LG G6 and LG W6 series televisions.
The launch will be centered around the Masters of the Universe movie, which will be coming to Prime Video. And if you don't mind feeling very silly indeed, you can declare "I have the POWER!" into the LG Magic Remote for LG Smart TVs with webOS 23 or later to bring up content relating to the movie release.
Creator Original is the more interesting addition, though. It promises to deliver more control to creators than Filmmaker Mode, because it takes the opposite approach: instead of removing your TV's image processing and enhancement as much as possible, Creator Original embraces it, but with rules.
What is Creator Original on LG OLED TVs?
According to LG, Creator Original will enable TV and movie studios to set key parameters such as shadow detail and color balance, and to control how how motion processing and noise reduction are being used in your TV's processing, all to deliver the creator's preferred visuals, in theory.
In the case of Masters of the Universe, LG says that enables its TVs to "faithfully reproduce every glowing sword clash, shadowy Skeletor lair and explosive battle across Eternia."
Interestingly, Creator Original's pitch sounds remarkably similar to what Dolby is planning with Dolby Vision 2. Dark area handling and control over motion handling control are key features of DV2, which has the same goal as Creator Original: making the most of the capabilities of high-powered TVs without sacrificing accuracy by putting control in the hands of movie makers, and using data in the file to tell the TV what to do.
However, Creator Original won't have the bi-directional tone mapping and certain other features of Dolby Vision 2 Max, which also has a new and improved image quality engine behind it.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
But still Creator Original looks like it may tick the most interesting boxes of DV2, and it has one big advantage over it: it looks like it's going to arrive first.
Dolby Vision 2 currently has one streaming partner, Peacock, and one filmmaking partner (StudioCanal), and there's no sign of a launch date as yet, though in discussions with Hisense and TCL we've learned that it's expected before the end of the year.
In contrast, LG says that Creator Original Mode for Prime Video "is scheduled to roll out by the end of this month," meaning July 2026, and if Prime Video adds support across more of its enviable Amazon Studios and MGM library, that could be a strong range of movies that use it. Of course, the fact that it only works on three TVs is a bit of a limitation.
When we asked LG if it has any plans to support Dolby Vision 2, it said that it would wait to see how support for the format evolves — but said we shouldn't expect current TVs to get it. So if you're thinking of buying the LG C6 or G6, this might be the best you can do for these kinds of next-gen image features.
As for the movie itself, we rather enjoyed it: in our Masters of the Universe review we said "it's the unrelentingly fun popcorn movie that [we] had expected recent Star Wars movie The Mandalorian and Grogu to be."

articles.title: Se acabó cambiar de aplicación: WhatsApp te permitirá la edición de archivos PDF desde el chat
articles.text:
WhatsApp continúa ampliando sus funciones más allá de la mensajería instantánea. La aplicación de Meta anunció una nueva integración con Adobe que permitirá abrir, revisar y realizar anotaciones en archivos PDF directamente desde una conversación, sin necesidad de descargar el documento o utilizar otra aplicación.
La novedad busca simplificar el trabajo de quienes utilizan WhatsApp para compartir documentos personales, académicos o laborales. Gracias a esta integración con Adobe Acrobat, los usuarios podrán acceder a herramientas básicas de edición como resaltar texto, subrayar, tachar o hacer anotaciones sin abandonar el chat, lo que reduce el tiempo necesario para revisar archivos y mejora la productividad.
PUBLICIDAD
Por el momento, la función estará disponible en WhatsApp Web y en la aplicación para Windows, donde el espacio de pantalla facilita el trabajo con documentos de varias páginas. Meta indicó que esta integración forma parte de una estrategia para incorporar servicios de terceros que amplíen las capacidades de la plataforma.
WhatsApp convierte los chats en un espacio para trabajar con documentos
Con el paso de los años, WhatsApp dejó de ser una aplicación destinada exclusivamente a las conversaciones personales.
Actualmente es una herramienta utilizada para coordinar reuniones, compartir contratos, enviar informes, revisar tareas académicas o intercambiar documentos de trabajo entre equipos y clientes.
En ese contexto, los archivos PDF se han convertido en uno de los formatos más utilizados dentro de la plataforma por su compatibilidad con prácticamente cualquier dispositivo y por conservar el diseño original del documento.
PUBLICIDAD
La nueva integración responde precisamente a esa realidad: permitir que el usuario pueda revisar un archivo sin interrumpir la conversación ni depender de programas externos.
Qué permite hacer la integración con Adobe Acrobat
La principal novedad es que los documentos PDF podrán abrirse directamente dentro de WhatsApp.
Una vez abierto el archivo, el usuario tendrá acceso a varias herramientas proporcionadas por Adobe Acrobat.
Entre las funciones disponibles se encuentran:
- Resaltar fragmentos de texto.
- Subrayar información importante.
- Tachar contenido.
- Dibujar sobre el documento.
- Agregar anotaciones o comentarios.
- Abrir archivos protegidos mediante contraseña.
Estas herramientas resultan especialmente útiles para revisar contratos, corregir documentos, estudiar apuntes o intercambiar observaciones con otras personas sin salir del entorno de WhatsApp.
De esta forma, la aplicación reduce la necesidad de descargar el documento, abrir otro programa, editar el archivo y volver posteriormente al chat para continuar la conversación.
PUBLICIDAD
Una función pensada para quienes usan WhatsApp en el trabajo
El crecimiento de WhatsApp como herramienta profesional ha impulsado el desarrollo de nuevas funciones orientadas a mejorar la productividad. Muchas empresas utilizan la aplicación para compartir presupuestos, presentaciones, reportes, manuales y otros documentos en formato PDF.
Hasta ahora, revisar esos archivos implicaba abandonar la conversación para abrir aplicaciones especializadas.
La integración con Adobe elimina ese paso intermedio y permite trabajar con mayor rapidez, especialmente cuando se reciben varios documentos durante una misma jornada laboral.
PUBLICIDAD
Asimismo, las anotaciones facilitan el intercambio de observaciones entre compañeros de trabajo sin modificar el contenido original del archivo.
Disponible inicialmente en WhatsApp Web y Windows
Meta confirmó que esta primera versión estará disponible para los usuarios de WhatsApp Web y de la aplicación oficial para Windows.
La decisión responde principalmente a que trabajar con documentos suele resultar más cómodo desde un computador gracias al mayor tamaño de la pantalla y al uso del teclado y el ratón.
PUBLICIDAD
Por ahora, la compañía no ha informado cuándo llegará esta función a los teléfonos Android, iPhone o la aplicación para iPad.
Sin embargo, la incorporación de Adobe Acrobat podría representar el primer paso hacia una integración más amplia en otros dispositivos durante futuras actualizaciones.
Meta apuesta por una plataforma cada vez más completa
Esta integración forma parte de una estrategia más amplia con la que Meta busca ampliar el ecosistema de WhatsApp.
En los últimos meses, la aplicación ha incorporado funciones como la creación de cuentas directamente desde el iPad, nuevas herramientas para CarPlay y Android Auto, mejoras en la publicación de música en los estados y una mayor compatibilidad entre dispositivos.
PUBLICIDAD
La llegada de servicios de terceros también abre la puerta a nuevas herramientas que podrían convertir a WhatsApp en un espacio donde los usuarios no solo conversen, sino también gestionen documentos, colaboren en proyectos y realicen tareas cotidianas sin cambiar constantemente de aplicación.
PUBLICIDAD
